API Reference

Wakapi API

v1.0

Contact: ferdinand@muetsch.io

REST API to interact with Wakapi

Authentication

Set header Authorization to your API Key encoded as Base64 and prefixed with Basic Example: Basic ODY2NDhkNzQtMTljNS00NTJiLWJhMDEtZmIzZWM3MGQ0YzJmCg==

Authentication

ApiKeyAuthapiKey

API Key: Authorization in header

badges

Get badge data

GET
https://merioneeason.github.io/compat/shields/v1/{user}/{interval}/{filter}

Retrieve total time for a given entity (e.g. a project) within a given range (e.g. one week) in a format compatible with Shields.io. Requires public data access to be allowed.

Get badge data
Copy
curl -X GET 'https://merioneeason.github.io/compat/shields/v1/string/today/string'
const response = await fetch('https://merioneeason.github.io/compat/shields/v1/string/today/string', {
  method: 'GET',
});

const data = await response.text();
import requests

response = requests.get('https://merioneeason.github.io/compat/shields/v1/string/today/string')
print(response.text)
200
Copy
{
  "color": "string",
  "label": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "schemaVersion": 0
}

Parameters

userstringrequiredpath

User ID to fetch data for

intervalstringtodayyesterdayweekmonthyear7_dayslast_7_days30_dayslast_30_days6_monthslast_6_months12_monthslast_12_monthslast_yearanyall_timerequiredpath

Interval to aggregate data for

filterstringrequiredpath

Filter to apply (e.g. 'project:wakapi' or 'language:Go')

Response

200OKv1.BadgeData

OK

Response fields application/json
colorstring
labelstring
messagestring
schemaVersioninteger

wakatime

List of users ranked by coding activity in descending order.

GET
https://merioneeason.github.io/compat/wakatime/v1/leaders

Mimics https://wakatime.com/developers#leaders

List of users ranked by coding activity in descending order.
Copy
curl -X GET 'https://merioneeason.github.io/compat/wakatime/v1/leaders' \
  -H 'Authorization: YOUR_TOKEN'
const response = await fetch('https://merioneeason.github.io/compat/wakatime/v1/leaders', {
  method: 'GET',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'YOUR_TOKEN',
  },
});

const data = await response.text();
import requests

response = requests.get(
    'https://merioneeason.github.io/compat/wakatime/v1/leaders',
    headers={
        'Authorization': 'YOUR_TOKEN',
    },
)
print(response.text)

Previously, all the following properties created a cascade foreign key constraint on the summary_items table back to this summary table resulting in 5 identical foreign key constraints on the summary_items table. This is not a problem for PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite, but for MSSQL (not supported anymore though), which complains about circular cascades on update/delete between these two tables. All of these created foreign key constraints are identical, so only one constraint is enough. MySQL will create a foreign key constraint for every property referencing other structs, even no constraint is specified in tags. So explicitly set gorm:"-" in all other properties to avoid creating duplicate foreign key constraints
